query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `callLogs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `callId` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `agentId` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `direction` enum('inbound','outbound') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inbound',
  `fromNumber` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `toNumber` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `callerName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `leadId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `summary` text,
  `transcript` mediumtext,
  `recordingUrl` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `durationSec` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `disconnectReason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `sentiment` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `intent` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `booked` tinyint DEFAULT 0,
  `startedAt` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `call_logs_call_id_uniq` (`callId`),
  KEY `call_logs_created_idx` (`createdAt`)
);
